claim: At genus two, 2A fermionization is an invertible 16-by-16 Arf-weighted Fourier transform; with a commuting order-23 insertion it reconstructs the ten even Baby-Monster amplitudes from sixteen Monster amplitudes with flat 2A backgrounds after division by the known free-Majorana factor.

reconstruction.input: order-23-twined genus-two Monster amplitudes for every flat 2A background

relationDefect.comparisonInvariants: three closed-cycle holonomies and one fixed-sector eigenvalue

boundary: The transform is exact but does not derive the sixteen higher-genus Monster background amplitudes from genus-one scalar traces.
